page: Amazon Web Services m8idb.8xlarge is a general-purpose, eighth-generation EC2 instance powered by dedicated Intel x86_64 processors operating at a clock speed of 3.9 GHz. Running on the AWS Nitro System hypervisor, the instance delivers 32 virtual CPUs distributed across 16 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading (2 threads per core). It is configured with 128.0 GB of system memory, matching a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU, and includes 33 Gbps of baseline network bandwidth.

A defining hardware characteristic of the m8idb.8xlarge is its bundled local high-speed storage, featuring 1900 GB of directly attached NVMe SSD instance storage. Because local instance store volumes are ephemeral, applications requiring persistence must handle replication or offloading to durable network storage. The instance operates without discrete GPU acceleration and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses, directing external routing through standard VPC networking mechanisms.

From a cost-efficiency and resource-allocation perspective, the m8idb.8xlarge provides a balanced hardware density of compute, memory, and fast temporary scratch space. This profile eliminates the network overhead typically associated with remote block storage for I/O-intensive temporary operations. It is well suited for enterprise database scratch pads, high-performance web and application backends, batch processing, continuous integration environments, and distributed data analytics workloads requiring high local read/write throughput.
description: Amazon Web Services m8idb.8xlarge is an eighth-generation general-purpose EC2 instance built on the AWS Nitro System. It is equipped with dedicated Intel x86_64 processors clocked at 3.9 GHz, providing 32 vCPUs across 16 physical cores with multithreading support. The configuration includes 128.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio, alongside 33 Gbps of baseline networking capacity. A key component of this instance is its bundled 1900 GB of local NVMe SSD instance storage, enabling low-latency, high-throughput I/O operations directly on the host hardware. Lacking discrete GPUs, the instance focuses on general compute tasks with significant local scratch space requirements. The m8idb.8xlarge is architected for demanding enterprise workloads such as transactional database servers, high-traffic web applications, in-memory caching nodes, continuous integration pipelines, and intermediate storage for extract, transform, load (ETL) processing.
